step: P4-R5, re-measured after the GlassDock split (B6, P3-R3): src/components/dock/__tests__ held 17 direct files. A kind slot takes no sub-directory (B5) and the dock/shell carve is refused at FD-2 (splits/src.md §5), so the slot is bounded by its own files: eight single-concern files merge into three by what they test, 17 to 12. Every describe and assertion is kept as written; the merged files share one import block; no file carries a module mock or a browser, so a merge changes no test's environment (the two that do, backdrop-mode and stagger, stay alone). 140 tests before and after

new: GlassDock under a press: the click-integrity and press-origin keepalive files, each kept whole under its own section
